sloka: न आददानाम् शरान् घोरान् विमुंचंतम् शर उत्तमान् ।विकर्षमाणम् पश्यन्ति राक्षसाः ते शर आर्दिताः ॥३-२५-३९॥
transliteration: na ādadānām śarān ghorān vimuṁcaṁtam śara uttamān ।vikarṣamāṇam paśyanti rākṣasāḥ te śara ārditāḥ ॥3-25-39॥

translations.english: Through the darkness created by the arrows that covered the sky and the Sun, Rama looked as though he was vomitting them.
